arxiv-1902-11108.title: Artist Style Transfer Via Quadratic Potential
arxiv-1902-11108.creator: Rahul Bhalley, Jianlin Su
arxiv-1902-11108.description: Abstract In this paper we address the problem of artist style transfer where the painting style of a given artist is applied on a real world photograph. We train our neural networks in adversarial setting via recently introduced quadratic potential divergence for stable learning process.

arxiv-2012-09850.creator: Jessica De Oliveira Moreira 1 , Amey Praveen Pasarkar 2 , Wenjun Chen 2 , Wenkai Hu 2 , Jan Janak 3 , Henning Schulzrinne 3
arxiv-2012-09850.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Jessica De Oliveira Moreira 1 , Amey Praveen Pasarkar 2 , Wenjun Chen 2 , Wenkai Hu 2 , Jan Janak 3 , Henning Schulzrinne 3. The COVID-19 pandemic and related restrictions forced many to work, learn, and socialize from home over the internet. There appears to be consensus that internet infrastructure in the developed world handled the resulting traffic surge well.

arxiv-2204-12787.title: 3-D generalized analytic signal associated with linear canonical transform in Clifford biquaternion domain
arxiv-2204-12787.creator: Zhen Feng Cai, Kit Ian Kou
arxiv-2204-12787.description: Abstract . The analytic signal is a useful mathematical tool. It separates qualitative and quantitative information of a signal in form of the local phase and local amplitude. The Clifford Fourier transform (CFT) plays a vital role in the representation of multidimensional signals.

arxiv-2205-05463.title: Valveless pumping at low Reynolds numbers
arxiv-2205-05463.creator: Gabriel Amselem, Christophe Clanet, Michael Benzaquen
arxiv-2205-05463.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gabriel Amselem, Christophe Clanet, Michael Benzaquen. Pumping at low Reynolds number is a ubiquitously encountered feature, both in biological organisms and engineered devices. Generating net flow requires the presence of an asymmetry in the system, which traditionally comes from geometric flow rectifiers. Here, we study a valveless system of N N oscillating pumps in series, where the asymmetry comes not from the geometry but from time, that is the phase shifts between the pumps. Experimental and theoretical results are in very good agreement.

arxiv-2302-00365.title: On tests of the quantum nature of gravitational interactions in presence of non-linear corrections to quantum mechanics
arxiv-2302-00365.creator: Giovanni Spaventa, Ludovico Lami, Martin B. Plenio
arxiv-2302-00365.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Giovanni Spaventa, Ludovico Lami, Martin B. Plenio. When two particles interact primarily through gravity and follow the laws of quantum mechanics, the generation of entanglement is considered a hallmark of the quantum nature of the gravitational interaction. However, we demonstrate that entanglement dynamics can also occur in the presence of a weak quantum interaction and non-linear corrections to local quantum mechanics, even if the gravitational interaction is classical or absent at short distances.

arxiv-2401-16784.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yibo Li, Xiao Wang †, Yujie Xing, Shaohua Fan, Ruijia Wang, Yaoqi Liu, Chuan Shi †. Graph neural networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable performance on graph-structured data. However, GNNs may inherit prejudice from the training data and make discriminatory predictions based on sensitive attributes, such as gender and race.

arxiv-2403-02941.title: Ruin Probability Approximation for Bidimensional Brownian Risk Model with Tax
arxiv-2403-02941.creator: Timofei Shashkov
arxiv-2403-02941.description: Abstract Abstract: Let \boldsymbol{B}(t)=(B_{1}(t),B_{2}(t)) , t\geq 0 be a two-dimensional Brownian motion with independent components and define the \boldsymbol{\gamma} -reflected process \boldsymbol{X}(t)=(X_{1}(t),X_{2}(t))=\left(B_{1}(t)-c_{1}t-\gamma_{1}\inf_{s_{1}\in[0,t]}(B_{1}(s_{1})-c_{1}s_{1}),B_{2}(t)-c_{2}t-\gamma_{2}\inf_{s_{2}\in[0,t]}(B_{2}(s_{2})-c_{2}s_{2})\right), with given finite constants c_{1},c_{2} and \gamma_{1},\gamma_{2}\in[0,2) . The goal of this paper is to derive the asymptotics of the ruin probability \mathbb{P}\left\{\exists_{t\in[0,T]}:X_{1}(t)>u,X_{2}(t)>au\right\} as u\to\infty for T>0 .

arxiv-2404-12921.title: Hydrodynamic attractor in ultracold atoms
arxiv-2404-12921.creator: Keisuke Fujii, Tilman Enss
arxiv-2404-12921.description: Abstract The hydrodynamic attractor is a concept that describes universal equilibration behavior in which systems lose microscopic details before hydrodynamics becomes applicable. We propose a setup to observe hydrodynamic attractors in ultracold atomic gases, taking advantage of the fact that driving the two-body s s -wave scattering length causes phenomena equivalent to isotropic fluid expansions.

arxiv-2412-06411.title: Quasiconformal variants of the Wong–Rosay theorem
arxiv-2412-06411.creator: Steven G. Krantz, Kaushal Verma
arxiv-2412-06411.description: Abstract . The Wong–Rosay theorem provides a characterization of the unit ball among all strongly pseudoconvex domains in terms of holomorphic automorphism group actions. We explore variants of this theorem in the quasiconformal setting. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 30C62, Secondary: 30C99 1. Introduction Let {\rm Aut}(D) denote the group of holomorphic automorphisms of a bounded domain D\subset\mathbb{C}^{n} .

arxiv-2501-18347.title: Description of di-hadron saturation signals within a universal nuclear parton distribution function approach
arxiv-2501-18347.creator: Dennis V. Perepelitsa
arxiv-2501-18347.description: Abstract Di-hadron and di-jet correlation measurements in proton–nucleus ( p p +A) and electron–nucleus collisions are widely motivated as sensitive probes of novel, non-linear QCD saturation dynamics in hadrons, which are particularly accessible in the dense nuclear environment at low values of Bjorken- x x ( OPEN x A ) x_{\mathrm{A}}) .

arxiv-2502-21146.title: Unmasking Stealthy Attacks on Nonlinear DAE Models of Power Grids
arxiv-2502-21146.creator: Abdallah Alalem Albustami, Ahmad F. Taha, Elias Bou-Harb
arxiv-2502-21146.description: Abstract Smart grids are inherently susceptible to various types of malicious cyberattacks that have all been documented in the recent literature. Traditional cybersecurity research on power systems often utilizes simplified models that fail to capture the interactions between dynamic and steady-state behaviors, potentially underestimating the impact of cyber threats.

arxiv-2601-17851.title: Joint constraint on the propagation origin of the cosmic-ray spectral knee from energy spectrum and anisotropy observations
arxiv-2601-17851.creator: Hua Yue, Lin Nie †, Yiqing Guo, Hongbo Hu
arxiv-2601-17851.description: Abstract The origin mechanism of the cosmic-ray knee region remains an unresolved mystery, with acceleration, interaction, and propagation models drawing significant attention. The latest experimental observations of the PeV total spectrum, composition energy spectrum, and anisotropy—particularly the precise measurements of the proton spectrum by the LHAASO experiment—have provided crucial breakthroughs in uncovering its origin.

pmc-11371777.title: Exacerbation of symptoms, nocturnal acid reflux, and impaired autonomic function are associated with sleep disturbance in gastroesophageal reflux disease patients
pmc-11371777.creator: Yizhou Huang, Jie Liu, Linsheng Xu, Wu Qi, Jie Dai, Bo Wang, Jiashuang Tian, Xin Fu, Yue Yu
pmc-11371777.description: Background and aimGastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) patients often report sleep disturbance (SD); however, the relationship between GERD and SD is unknown. This study investigated whether SD affects symptoms, acid reflux, and autonomic function in GERD patients.MethodsA total of 257 subjects (126 patients with SD and 99 patients without SD) participated in this survey from January 2020 to August 2022.

pmc-11388579.title: Migration and accumulation patterns of plastic waste in the environment: A comprehensive simulation study
pmc-11388579.creator: Zayinatun Biladiyah Al Khoeriyah, Emenda Sembiring
pmc-11388579.description: Plastic waste is commonly littered in the environment due to insufficient waste management practices. Mismanaged plastic waste may migrate and accumulate in terrestrial and aquatic environments. Plastic waste in the terrestrial environment is our topic of interest, as it can significantly contribute to the broader issue of plastic waste pollutants.

pmc-13385224.title: Effect of complement 3/5 knockout on renal proteomics landscape after ischemia and reperfusion injury in rats
pmc-13385224.creator: Dinesh Bhattarai, Amod Sharma, Madison McGraw, Se‐Ran Jun, Neelam Joshi, Neriman Gokden, Samuel Mackintosh, Nirmala Parajuli
pmc-13385224.description: Ischemia–reperfusion injury (IRI) is a major driver of acute kidney injury and development of chronic kidney disease. Although complement activation worsens IRI, the roles of upstream (C3) versus downstream (C5) components remain unclear. Renal IRI was surgically induced in C3 knockout (C3−/−) and C5 knockout (C5−/−) Lewis rats, and the renal function as well as histopathology were systematically assessed.

pmc-13520245.title: Increased LDL-C reduction with ezetimibe in ketogenic diet-induced hypercholesterolemia
pmc-13520245.creator: Jorge Gonzalez, Joshua Wageman, Laura Buchanan, Tro Kalayjian, Matthew Calkins, Erin Saner, Adrian Soto-Mota
pmc-13520245.description: Several case reports and a meta-analysis have documented significant increases in cholesterol levels among individuals following a ketogenic diet. However, the mechanistic drivers of this phenotype remain incompletely understood. Here, we describe a retrospective case series of 14 patients with ketogenic diet-induced hypercholesterolemia who experienced larger-than-expected LDL-C reductions after ezetimibe therapy.

pmc-13579852.title: Multimodal AI and single-cell transcriptomics integrate to construct a histopathological prognostic model for bladder cancer, revealing the RTN3-glycolysis axis in chemoresistance
pmc-13579852.creator: Shunli Yu, Yingjian Wang, Dapeng Feng, Xinglai Dai, Yongbo Luo, Jianing Wang, Zihe Wang, Fuxiang Chen, Haoran Wang, Fengyan Tian, Xuejia Zhai, Chaohui Gu
pmc-13579852.description: BackgroundBladder cancer is a common malignant tumor of the urinary system, and gemcitabine-based chemotherapy often fails because of drug resistance. Tumor heterogeneity, particularly copy number variations (CNVs) heterogeneity at the genomic level, is a core factor that drives disease progression and drug resistance.

pmc-13596059.title: Nilotinib revisited in GIST: salvage use in patients with severe imatinib toxicity
pmc-13596059.creator: Johanna Falkenhorst, Peter Hohenberger, Giorgia Mancino, Andrea Scrima, Franka Menge, Benjamin S Fletcher, Carina Reiff, Valerie Lange, Rainer Hamacher, Stefanie Bertram, Fiona M Rau, Yasmin Zaun, Moritz Kaths, Jürgen Treckmann, Jens Jakob, Thomas Mühlenberg, Susanne Grunewald, Dawid Krzeciesa, Dani
pmc-13596059.description: BackgroundSevere imatinib toxicity is a rare, but relevant event in GIST patients. Other approved treatments were not evaluated within a first-line setting and exhibit severe adverse events that limit QoL. Nilotinib was evaluated within this setting in GIST with a safety profile comparable to imatinib and effectiveness within KIT-exon-11-mutant GIST subgroup (ENESTg1).
